title: Poi with Coconut
description: Solomon Islands-inspired starchy poi with coconut. This version makes a smooth cooked-taro purée; local poi recipes vary by island and root crop.

steps.instruction: Peel purchased edible taro and boil in plenty of water until fully soft, 30–35 minutes. Drain thoroughly.
Mash the hot cooked taro into a smooth, dense paste, adding a spoonful of hot water only if needed.
Warm coconut cream gently with a pinch of salt; stir most into the taro and reserve some to pour on top.
Shape onto a platter, pour over remaining coconut cream and serve warm.
